content.short: Tide enables creators and businesses to issue on-chain credentials with a no-code builder.
content.description: Tide offers a credential builder that lets projects issue credentials to their community based on on-chain (smart contract interactions) or off-chain triggers, enabling credential issuance for a variety of actions and milestones. This approach reflects Tide’s aim to help communities grow and engage by tying participation to credentials, addressing the rising costs of customer acquisition and the challenges of loyalty programs. Tide is used by NFTperp, Pooltogheter, Premia finance, and many other projects.
content.meta: Tide enables creators and businesses to create on-chain credentials using a no-code builder. Discover Tide and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
